study_note: Two H3 MPPI full-training controls with the same primary outer learning recipe as the full AMBI J6/J8 experiments. Both use 8 effective planning iterations, 512 candidates, 64 elites, 24 SAC-policy trajectories, temperature 0.5, std 0.05–2, and episode-scoped shifted plan means. The aux-return cell retains its shared-representation auxiliary reward-return critic and uses it for the terminal score. The soft-Q cell disables auxiliary critic allocation and training and uses the original online entropy-augmented SAC critic for the terminal score; removing the auxiliary learner also removes its loss contribution to the shared representation. Both score model rewards plus terminal Q at sampled SAC actions with mean_pair reduction, without explicit rollout entropy additions. TD-MPC2-style weighted elite selection; training adds proposal-scaled Gaussian noise and evaluation does not. No inner gradient updates or Bernoulli transfer. Seed 55, 500k decisions/1M raw environment steps, 2500 warmup and 2500 pretrain updates; retain checkpoints every 25k decisions. Separate primary/auxiliary ensemble execution in the aux-return cell matches the launched SAC campaign. Existing evaluation cadence remains disabled; paired checkpoint evaluation and CUDA throughput gating are separate prelaunch work.
